name: prompto
description: Prompt management webapp with Kanban UI

scripts.dev: npm run setup:web && concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client"
scripts.dev:grab: npm run setup:web && concurrently "npm run server" "cd client && npm run dev:grab"
scripts.install-all: npm run security:deps && npm ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.electron:dev: npm run setup:electron && concurrently "npm run client" "wait-on http://localhost:3080 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:build: rm -rf node_modules/better-sqlite3/build && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:mac: rm -rf node_modules/better-sqlite3/build && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:win: rm -rf node_modules/better-sqlite3/build && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:linux: rm -rf node_modules/better-sqlite3/build && npm run build && electron-builder --linux

author: Michele Melis
